item.title: Nicotine Pouches Marketed as 'Lower Risk' Than Cigarettes: Is That Safe?
item.description: The FDA allowed some Zyn nicotine pouches to be marketed as 'lower risk' than cigarettes. Experts agree they can help current smokers, but concerns remain.

item.title: House Ethics Committee Investigates Ohio Republican Max Miller
item.description: The House Ethics Committee has opened an investigation into Rep. Max Miller after the Ohio Republican requested a probe into domestic abuse allegations.

item.title: Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv region kills 17
item.description: Overnight strikes on Kyiv and surrounding areas killed 17 and wounded 44, according to Ukraine's President.

item.title: Black lung rates in Appalachia hit highest level in nearly 50 years
item.description: Rates match 1970s levels, with thousands of miners affected. Experts blame toxic silica dust now common in mines.
